bull_bear.body:
- Very high capital buffer: CRAR 32.33% and CET-1 31.30% as of Q1FY27 (vs 31.55% and 29.99% in Q1FY26); the deck flags "Capital Adequacy @ 32.33%".
- Liquidity and leverage run far above minimums: LCR 140.74% vs 100.00% minimum, NSFR 150.74% vs 100.00% minimum, Leverage Ratio 12.50% vs 3.50% minimum, all as of 30.06.26.
- Balance-sheet headroom for lending: actual CD ratio 88.97% against a computed "max possible" 99.03% as of 30.06.26 (deposits 80.73% of liabilities, mandatory/minimum required 20.05%, lending possible 79.95%).
- Net worth Rs 10,562 crore and Book Value Per Share Rs 667.00 in Q1FY27 (from Rs 9,328 crore and Rs 589.09 in Q1FY26); capital unchanged at Rs 158.35 crore across all five quarters shown.
- Provisioning buffers held ahead of ECL: of the Rs 324 crore additional provision required, Rs 276 crore is already available -- Rs 250 crore covid contingency provision plus Rs 26 crore for stressed NFB (provided 100% in Q1FY27).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Branding line on the cover reads "Trusted Since 1921", "Modernizing for the Future" and "Banking on Growth"; CIN L65110TN1921PLC001908 and Head Office at 57 V.E. Road, Thoothukudi.
- Business is overwhelmingly granular: RAM Advances are 94.38% of gross advances as of Q1FY27 (107 Bps YoY), with Retail, Agriculture and MSME the three reported RAM legs.
- Unsecured exposure is described as "Strategically Contained" at 0.10% of total advances (18 Bps YoY); the deck labels overall performance "Disciplined Performance" and "Growth Carefully Engineered".
- Geographically concentrated in Tamil Nadu: of 628 total branches as of 30.06.26, 457 are TN and 171 are non-TN.
- Deck claims total business growth is "Highest in last 14 years" and "7%+ over industry growth", against an 8.82% 10-year CAGR moving to 23%.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [ECL transition] New ECL norms apply w.e.f. 01.04.2027: current IRAC provisions total Rs 519 crore (standard assets Rs 172 cr, bad & doubtful Rs 242 cr, non-performing investment Rs 56 cr, floating provision Rs 24 cr, other Rs 25 cr) vs ECL total Rs 843 crore (Stage 1 Rs 254 cr, Stage 2 Rs 179 cr, Stage 3 Rs 410 cr), a one-time additional provision requirement of Rs 324 crore as of 30.06.2026.
- [Enforcement Directorate] Two show cause notices outstanding. SCN 1 (17.12.2014) on alleged contraventions in transfer of shares carried a Rs 17 crore penalty; on appeal, the Appellate Tribunal order pronounced 09.07.26 partly allowed the appeal, reduced the penalty to Rs 3.40 crore, entitles the Bank to receive the excess Rs 13.60 crore, and dismissed ED's claim for confiscation of shares held by a foreign investor, with further course of action under examination.
- [Enforcement Directorate] SCN 2 (09.11.2017) relates to alleged contraventions in issuance of bonus shares for Rs 1037 crore and adjudication is still pending.
- [Shareholding] As of 30.06.2026 the pattern is Public 56.803%, Overseas Corporate Bodies 22.425% (unchanged across all three dates shown), Others 13.465%, Foreign Portfolio Investors 6.730% and Mutual Funds 0.577% -- FPI and MF holdings have risen from 4.576% and 0.000% at 30.06.2025.
- [Asset quality direction] Total stressed assets (standard restructured plus gross NPA) fell to Rs 606.25 crore, a stressed assets ratio of 1.06% in Q1FY27 from 1.88% in Q1FY26; collateral coverage on NPAs averages 145.28%, and the deck states portfolio loss is expected to be low with potential for write-back of most provisions.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Tamilnad Mercantile Bank as a Thoothukudi-headquartered, Tamil Nadu-anchored old private bank -- "Trusted Since 1921 / Modernizing for the Future / Banking on Growth" -- running a granular, near-fully-secured RAM (Retail-Agri-MSME) book with a very large gold-loan share, sector-leading capital adequacy and steadily declining NPAs.
